Prior member experience / 2023–2025

Nila Baharuddin.

Building an Indonesian fashion label’s presence in Japan.

At a glance

Organization / context
Nila Baharuddin
Market
Indonesia → Japan · Tokyo
Member
Rinintha Pradiza
Year
2023–2025
Capabilities
Research & Strategy / Partnerships & Market Access / IP & Creative
¥1M+Daimaru pop-up retail sales

Project scope

Japan market development across FEELSEEN Ginza, NEW ENERGY Tokyo and Daimaru Tokyo, connecting brand strategy, cultural storytelling and retail.

The challenge

Translate an Indonesian designer’s proposition into credible gallery, trade-fair and department-store experiences in Japan.

Member contribution

As Brand Marketing Manager, Rinintha led strategy, storytelling, production coordination, pricing, inventory, shipping, PR and retail support. Following an introduction by a Japan-based consultant, she managed the Daimaru buyer relationship and helped develop the pop-up.

Outcome

The program progressed from Ginza to a Tokyo trade fair and department-store retail. The two-week Daimaru pop-up surpassed ¥1 million in retail sales, a project result supported by the wider team.

This work predates dot.wave. Project outcomes belong to the wider project and its collaborators; the contribution above identifies the member’s role.
